boundaries: Rounded level labels and photon energies are not independent data. The anchor is an arbitrary zero for the fitted relative level energies.
The caption adds about0.3 keV; quadrature and per-line independence are declared exercise assumptions. No experimental covariance was supplied.
Common offset/gain uncertainties, the3-keV corruption and the doublet-order calculation are counterfactual controls, not measured calibration errors or revised levels.
Energy closure assumes photon energies equal level gaps at the printed precision; exact photon recoil is outside this exercise.
Source final multipolarity labels are assignments, not measurements of delta=0. Shared doublet R/A cannot be assigned to each component independently.
Intensity ratios are conditional photon-intensity ratios, not total branching probabilities, lifetimes, absolute B values or collective-mode evidence.
Table I, Figure2 and Figure5 share one acquisition. The13/2+ bandhead half-life is an external Ref7 dependency, not a parent lifetime for these seven lines.
